component.name: plaa
component.summary: Play video and audio files and streams

description.p: plaa is a fast, lightweight media player, similar to QuickTime Player and IINA. It plays nearly every video and audio format through FFmpeg, decoding on the graphics card where it can.

ul.li: One window per file, with controls that float over the picture and slide away while you watch
Audio and subtitle tracks, ASS subtitles as styled, playback speed with the pitch kept, A-B loops and frame stepping
Streams from the network, such as HLS, DASH and RTSP, and web videos through yt-dlp
HDR video shown on ordinary screens, and 8K played smoothly on the graphics card
Trimming, splitting and exporting, on the graphics card's encoder where there is one
Recording sound, the screen and a camera
Casting to Chromecasts and DLNA renderers
A spectrum, waveform or Prism, a scene in three dimensions, for sound files
Sending and playing AVB and Milan network audio
An assistant using a model of your choice
Starts where you left off, and saves frames as pictures
Material 3 design, with colors from the system accent color

description.p: Agents and the assistant read and edit what plays, with FFmpeg filters and other files' sound mixed in; Make Default; one side panel at a time; and AVB network audio played on a Mac.
The first release: playback, streams and web videos, editing and export, recording, casting, the visualizer, AVB network audio and the assistant.
